error.description: A sample of a mistake with an occurrence count, minted by the reporter so resends land once.

hits.description: Occurrences represented by this sample; omitted means one.

message.description: The failure sentence when nothing was thrown.

fault.description: An explicit group key, otherwise computed downstream.

bug.description: The group written by the grouper.

commit.description: The commit sha of the running code.

version.description: The app version that produced the error.

tags.description: Additional catch context; never request headers, cookies or bodies.

during.description: What an error happened among, by global eid.

entity.description: The call, effect, entry or process being run.

session.description: The session whose work raised the error.

process.description: The process when the entity does not already name it.

kind.description: The served entity’s kind, read where it happened.

breadcrumbs.description: The last twenty page navigations, API calls and console errors.

exception.description: The tracker’s stack, parsed frames and catch mechanism for a thrown value.

stack.description: The stack trace, as the runtime reported it.

mechanism.description: The hook that caught the throw.

regressed.description: A resolved bug returned in code that had not produced it before resolution.

error.description: The occurrence that brought the bug back.

taken.description: A fixer started on the bug. Written again when a fixer takes it after a regression.

task.description: The work item, by the name the graph working on it gives it (T-123).

error_group.description: Group each ungrouped occurrence, atomically counting and linking it.

bug_notify.description: Notify new or regressed bugs, excluding archived or already notified ones.

bug_follow.description: Tell a bug's letter thread when a fixer takes the bug and when it is resolved or archived, once per mark, and once per opening for taken.

error_trim.description: Keep the newest hundred occurrences and the first of each commit or version.

bug_list.title: List bugs
bug_list.description: List bugs, open by default. Answers source-labelled rows as text and output.value for either store.

source.description: Read box bugs (default) or the platform tracker on yaks.app. Reads return source-labelled data without importing bundles.

bug_show.title: Show bugs
bug_show.description: Read a bug and its retained occurrences. Answers source-labelled rows as text and output.value for either store.

bug.description: Box bug id or title; for yaks.app, the bug’s global eid.

source.description: Read box bugs (default) or the platform tracker on yaks.app. Reads return source-labelled data without importing bundles.

bug_resolve.title: Resolve bugs
bug_resolve.description: Mark that the problem stopped happening. Box marks reach the configured remote tracker before the local mark; yaks.app marks only the platform tracker.

bug.description: Box bug id or title; for yaks.app, the bug’s global eid.

source.description: Mark box bugs (default), including their remote copy when configured, or the platform tracker on yaks.app.

bug_archive.title: Archive bugs
bug_archive.description: Hide a bug without discarding occurrences. Box marks reach the configured remote tracker before the local mark; yaks.app marks only the platform tracker.

bug.description: Box bug id or title; for yaks.app, the bug’s global eid.

source.description: Mark box bugs (default), including their remote copy when configured, or the platform tracker on yaks.app.

error_frames.description: Resolve grouped stack frames through the code catalog without recounting occurrences; allow ten attempts with pool backoff for catalog restarts, and retry unresolved records when the pool starts.
